description: Create personalized, source-grounded travel dossiers from a destination, dates, duration, travelers, and constraints. Ask only the questions that change the plan, use explicitly permitted personal context without exposing it, research current logistics, and produce a cited, visually coherent PDF or responsive companion web page. Use when someone wants an individualized itinerary, trip brief, travel field guide, or shareable travel website. Do not use for real-time booking, ticket purchasing, visa or legal advice, or generic destination summaries without a specific traveler and trip.
